mapper.update: UPDATE `s-seckill`.t_seckill_product SET stock_count = stock_count - 1 WHERE id = #{seckillId} AND stock_count > 0
UPDATE `s-seckill`.t_seckill_product SET stock_count = stock_count + 1 WHERE id = #{seckillId}
mapper.select: SELECT sp.id, sp.product_id, sp.seckill_price, sp.stock_count, p.product_name, p.product_title, p.product_price FROM `s-seckill`.t_seckill_product sp LEFT JOIN `s-product`.t_product p ON p.id = sp.product_id WHERE sp.time = #{time} ORDER BY sp.id

SELECT id, product_name, product_title, product_detail, product_price FROM `s-product`.t_product WHERE id IN
#{id}
